originalAttempt: Authorized publish.ps1 staged only learning\S015, then failed at git diff --cached --check before commit/tag/push.
cause: Omitting blank-at-eof from a positive Git whitespace attribute list does not disable that default check. It requires the explicit negative -blank-at-eof token.
recovery: Change only owned attributes, the directly related test/docs/metadata, keep raw syntax logs unchanged, rerun scoped integrity and authorized publisher. No reset, stash, broad staging, shared-source edit, or force push.
